text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen... It has come at last,

Trainer—our first major clash with the
generation
of yesteryear.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I've had several opportunities to
challenge them
before.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
However, only a stage of this magnitude
will
suffice for my opening ceremony.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: They won't be holding back, either.

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Both Спешл Уик and Grass
Wonder
have come, thus fulfilling their
promises.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Their grit has earned my respect. I,
though, shall
be victorious!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Today's the big day, Opera O!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Please, pay me no mind. I myself will be
heeding
no distractions.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehe! Snort! That posture... That extreme focus...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That is your essence, through and
through. You
two are worth
surpassing—twin peaks of the older

generation, Grass and Spe.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Т.М. Опера О turns to the fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hear me, spectators whose hearts beat
with
adoration for Umamusume!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Today, I stand on the track of the Arima
Kinen for
the first time.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It is the past versus the present. Here I
am, to ring
the opening bell...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And to serenade the architects of a
golden age
with respect—and
foreboding doom!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Once the gates open, the sun shall sink
into the
horizon, plunging Nakayama
Racecourse into a
prolonged night.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The battle shall unfold in the deepest
darkness,
growing ever darker even as
dawn approaches.
However...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
No matter how horrific the ensuing strife

becomes, not a soul shall sleЭпизод.. until
this score is
settled once and for all.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But in the end, I shall arise the victor,
bringing
with me a new, shining dawn!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Witness it with your own eyes, you
spectators!
The dawn of a new age!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, set forth, we leaders of our times!
Onto the
arena of this singular
encounter!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: All right!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Gladly.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The fire Opera O has lit burns in the
eyes of her
two competitors.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's taking the leap from being the
Overlord of
her generation to the
Centurial Overlord of all
generations...
Her true battle is about to begin!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
